sources.name: Lena Okafor
sources.quote: To be honest, I just didn't want to stop. I'd had a good run, and I was on a roll. We'd just gotten that windfall, $14,000, and it was nice to feel like I was doing something for myself that night. Plus, the kids were doing well, and my husband was supportive as always. I wasn't thinking about the standings or the credits too much; I just flew until the show ended.
